name: application-card-freeze-toggle
title: Card Freeze Toggle
description: Bank-card visual that grayscales and gains a 'Frozen' overlay together with a toggled switch, both driven by the same real frozen state.
useWhen: Letting a user temporarily freeze/unfreeze a payment card from an account or card-management screen.
The frozen state benefits from a visual treatment on the card artwork itself (grayscale + overlay), not just a label change.
You need the switch and the card's visual state to always agree, since a mismatch here could mislead a user about their card's real status.
avoidWhen: You're toggling a smart-home device rather than a payment card — use `device-toggle-tile` for that icon-and-grid pattern instead.
There's no card artwork to show — a plain labeled switch is enough.
The action is irreversible or requires confirmation (e.g. permanently canceling a card) — add a confirmation step rather than a plain toggle.
responsiveBehavior: Fixed-width card (max-w-xs) with an aspect-video card face that scales with container width while keeping its proportions.
accessibility: The switch uses role="switch" with aria-checked reflecting real frozen state, and the card's grayscale/overlay treatment is derived from that same state.
Frozen status is conveyed as visible text ('Card is frozen' / 'Card is active') in addition to the visual card treatment, never by color or grayscale alone.
The card number is masked to only the last four digits, matching real-world PCI display conventions.

variants.title: Card Freeze Toggle
variants.description: Tessera Card ending in 4831, active by default; toggling the switch grayscales the card face and shows a Frozen overlay badge.
accessibility: Card grayscale, overlay visibility, switch aria-checked, and status text are all derived from the same frozen boolean.

variants.title: Card Freeze Toggle (Dark)
variants.description: Card freeze toggle adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Switch and status text colors are tuned to meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark surface.
